title: What the Price of a Vacation Package Covers, and What Is Charged Beside It
content:
The package price covers exactly what the product includes: meals, drinks, gratuities, transfers and a tour manager are included or charged separately entirely according to the product booked. This is the basis the desk applies across the Vacation Package Products.

## When a component may be priced onto the ledger

A component is priced onto the ledger only while the package record stands at deposit held, confirmed or travelling. The state relied on is the one the package record itself shows for the package the component is being priced against, correlated by that package's own reference; a party's statement that the holiday is under way is not the basis of this test.

| Package record stands at | A component may be priced onto the ledger |
| --- | --- |
| quoted | no |
| deposit held | yes |
| confirmed | yes |
| travelling | yes |
| completed | no |
| cancelled | no |
| closed | no |

## Charges beside the price

Gratuities are charged per traveller per day on a product that does not include them, and port charges are charged per traveller once for a sailing.

An excursion or resort credit is granted per traveller at departure, must be spent within the product's validity days counted from departure, and is forfeited unspent.

Excursions booked in advance carry the product's advance discount, and the same excursion bought on site does not.

Upgrades are sold only on a product that allows them, at the product's own amounts, and never convert the package to the upgraded product's terms.

Visa assistance is charged per traveller at the product's amount and is never refunded once the application has been lodged.

## A point of judgement on the upgrade clause

The two limbs of the upgrade clause are separate: a product that allows upgrades sells them at its own published amounts, and the sale changes no other term of the package. A party upgraded within one of the Vacation Package Products remains on the product they booked, with that product's deposit, payment, amendment and cancellation figures unchanged.
